title: House Robber
description:
A row of houses each holds some money. You may not take from two neighbouring houses (an alarm would sound). Find the largest total amount you can take.

Input format
Line 1: n.
Line 2: n non-negative integers, the money in each house.

Output format
One integer: the maximum amount.
hints: Look at the last house. Either you take it or you do not. What does each choice allow for the houses before it?
Let best[i] be the answer for the first i houses: best[i] = max(best[i-1], best[i-2] + money[i-1]).
Greedily taking every other house, or the larger of "even positions" and "odd positions", is not always optimal: sometimes you must skip two houses in a row.
